## Welcome!

Welcome to the Workshop site for the **Digital Research Skills Network**! Whether you're just starting out with R or looking to strengthen your skills, this site is designed to foster a digital community centered around biomedical research programmatic analysis. 
 
Workshop material will aim to use publicly available data or mock created data. Therefore, you will not need to rely on uploaded data from the demonstrators/creators. Instead, a pre-workshop set-ups will include instructions for where to download and prep relevant data. 

<hint-text style="text-size:1.2em; color:black"><i>**Bookmark this site for quick access to scripts and updates as workshops progress.**</i></hint-text>

<span style="display:inline-block; width:80%;"><wimr></span>



#### <u>*Upcoming Events*</u>

## [<i>**From Acquisition to Analysis:**</i>](https://drthomasoneil.github.io/Digital-Research-Skills-Network/202507.html)

<i>**Practical Tips for Imaging Data**</i>

Join us for a practical seminar exploring how to optimise your imaging workflow from the point of acquisition through to quantitative analysis. This session is tailored for researchers working with whole-slide imaging and QuPath-based workflows.

**Dr Hong Yu** will begin by covering essential tips and tricks for acquiring and processing images. She will focus on preparing high-quality data for downstream analysis and highlight common pitfalls and quality issues to avoid. **Elizabeth Dunn** will lead a live tutorial on how to work with images in QuPath. This hands-on session will walk through both qualitative and quantitative workflows.

This seminar is ideal for anyone working with whole-slide images and looking to improve their data quality, analysis skills, or integration between VS200 and QuPath workflows.

</div>
